features.name: measurement_and_validation
implemented: Separate phase timers and effective settings
Versioned bounded checksummed atomic local records
Filesystem observation epochs and corruption misses

features.name: evaluation
implemented: Owned normalized statement programs for assignment, rule, recipe, conditional, include, export, undefine and VPATH operations
Fresh-bootstrap replay through ordinary mutation APIs with origin, flavor, precedence, exports, automatic and target-specific scope validation
Nested dynamic variable names, call/foreach bindings, secondary expansion and dynamically parsed eval body programs
Ordered symbol interning and variable-use observations, including undefined lookups
Native file, wildcard and native find observations with positive and negative dependencies
Exactly-once ordered arbitrary effects with downstream pure value reuse and in-place operand replacement
boundaries: Persistent reuse applies to Ninja generation; direct mode remains the behavioral reference
Diagnostics, unsupported variable metadata and uncertain observations use ordinary evaluation at their current boundary
Effectful enclosing regions are not cached; current nested statement regions can still be reused
Native find validation accepts only complete quiet interpreter results; it never executes arbitrary shell text

features.name: includes
implemented: Validated no-work include certificates
Producer/prerequisite and negative search observations
Graph and environment identities bound to the accepted certificate
boundaries: Phony work, VPATH, unresolved dependencies, observable effects and incomplete proofs use ordinary remaking
Certificate stores the validated dependency closure rather than a general replayable include graph

features.name: recursive
implemented: Preflighted standalone static child graphs
Scoped subninja fragments with child cwd and exports
Parent prerequisite gates, budget validation, ownership and cycle checks
boundaries: Generated includes, implicit rules, dynamic discovery and unresolved environments retain recursion
Special execution modes, load constraints, target MAKEFLAGS, depfile detection, pools, WAIT, precious/ignored outputs and diagnostics retain recursion
General Kbuild and shell-loop import are unsupported

features.name: outputs_and_compact
implemented: Explicit write-if-changed stdout contract
Preserved unchanged mtime, regular-file mode, producer stderr and failures
Failed comparisons preserve prior outputs
Shared native launcher templates with per-edge quoted scripts, cleanup arguments and depfiles
boundaries: No automatic recipe rewriting or transitive reduction
Symlink/directory outputs rejected; compact fallback for special outputs and large response files

features.name: monitor
implemented: Explicit Linux start/status/stop
Private workspace socket and inotify watches
Sequence checkpoints spanning validation
Restart, overflow, lost coverage and unsupported filesystem fallback
boundaries: Regular single-link unambiguous local files only
Absent, symlink, uncovered and unsupported paths use ordinary validation

retained_findings.finding: One extra app relink in an earlier safe-j4 external run; executable mtime preceded prerequisites although artifacts matched. Isolated baseline/off/safe/aggressive checks and full repeats passed; cause unresolved.

Windows-mounted external campaign produced inconsistent timestamp ordering, including extra work in the GNU Make oracle. All safe/aggressive j1/j4 native-volume comparisons passed for preceding state-replay candidates. Windows runs remain nonacceptance evidence.

Fresh native WSL LLVM 19 campaign crashed in the unchanged baseline during the first clean warmup, mm/debug.c. No measured pairs. Exact standalone compile passed three times with identical output; 400 standalone frontend probes and one fresh GNU Make clean control passed with the same configuration. Root cause remains unconfirmed.

Stopped independent-builder v2 campaign during its second discarded warmup for reproduced cache correctness fixes. No measured pairs. Both first-pair full Linux clean builds succeeded on AMD. Superseded binary and all raw evidence retained.

Final-candidate native-volume external safe-j1 comparison reports extra work only in the GNU Make oracle's baseline no-op. Its log explicitly warns generated.h is 0.44 seconds in the future; recorded generated.h mtime follows all three objects and the link despite being generated first. Candidate direct and Ninja comparisons pass. Environment clock ordering invalidates this attempt; a complete fresh repeat is retained separately.

Opaque recursive invocations originally reverted to safe defaults, defeating full-build feature ablations. Reproduced with parent off and child statistics. Fixed using private versioned graph settings; reserved against ordinary and export-all Make materialization. Direct/Ninja nested recursion coverage passes at j1/j8/j16.

Interrupted independent-builder cache-v2 campaign before its first measured clean result to fix recursive feature propagation. Two discarded warmup pairs (20 scenario rows), zero measured rows; source integrity passes. All raw evidence retained.

Instrumented baseline clean diagnostic never reached compilation: host perf prepended /host/usr/bin to child PATH, selecting a host mkfifo requiring GLIBC_2.43 unavailable in the image. Stopped the FIFO retry loop. Corrected profiler adapter resets PATH with absolute image /bin/env; FIFO preflight passes. This is an invalid instrumentation run, not a Linux compiler or candidate failure.
retained_findings.raw_retention: perf.data.gz; original SHA verified after decompression before removing uncompressed data

retained_findings.finding: The invalid instrumentation run exposed an existing unbounded FIFO-creation retry on every mkfifo error. Fixed launcher to retry existing-name collisions with a 1024-attempt bound and promptly report other errors, preserving the underlying diagnostic and all pre-existing paths. Regression covers tool failure and a dangling-symlink collision.
